payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort firecracker times, then greedily compute how many can be used by simulating drop times sequentially, ensuring gaps of at least 1 second.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts the firecracker delays (standard sort) and uses a greedy scheduling algorithm to count feasible drops before the guard catches. No custom sort key, sweep line, or binary search is used; sorting is the only relevant operation among candidates. Closest is sorting_custom_key but match is weak.
